news_context: The United States and Iran are scheduled to resume direct negotiations in Doha on July 18, focusing on the Strait of Hormuz and regional stability. Amidst these diplomatic efforts, European governments have shifted their stance to accept potential transit fees for shipping through the Strait as inevitable.
